script.spokenText: Did you know sewer repairs uncovered a pool named in John’s Gospel? In 2004, workers exposed stone steps south of Jerusalem’s Old City. Archaeologists uncovered a huge stepped pool dated to the late Second Temple period. John chapter nine places Jesus healing a blind man at the Pool of Siloam. The pool likely served the city’s pilgrims. Here is the surprising part: archaeology recovered the setting of the story, not proof of the miracle. It shows a monumental pool stood in the right place and era. The evidence reaches the pool. The miracle remains a matter of faith.
